title: Comunicado 2026-03-26
summary: Banxico resumed the easing cycle with a 25bp cut to 6.75%, taken by a 3-2 majority: Rodríguez Ceja, Cuadra and Mejía voted for the cut, while Borja and Heath voted to hold at 7.00%. The Board justified the move on the observed exchange-rate levels, the marked weakness of activity and the degree of restriction already in place, and judged the resulting stance adequate to face a prolonged Middle East conflict; guidance opens the door to one more cut, but only as something whose 'pertinencia y momento' will be weighed. Versus the previous communique (5 February, a unanimous pause with a generic two-sided path), the message flips from pause to cutting with a single-sided easing guidance, a clear dovish shift in action. The hawkish brakes are the split vote and a worse inflation picture: headline rose to 4.63% on non-core, core stayed near 4.5%, 2026 forecasts and expectations were revised up and the risk balance stays tilted up. Net, a cut with room for one modest additional move, pulled up by a closely divided Board.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó apropiado en esta ocasión continuar con el ciclo de disminuciones de la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Resumes the easing cycle after the February pause

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, conforme la evolución de las condiciones macroeconómicas y financieras lo amerite, la Junta de Gobierno valorará la pertinencia y el momento de realizar un recorte adicional a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Guidance: one more cut on the table, timing and pertinence data-dependent

key_quotes.quote: Votaron a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 7.00% Galia Borja Gómez y Jonathan Heath.
key_quotes.context: Two dissents for a hold make it a 3-2 decision -- the main hawkish counterweight

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Upside risk balance kept despite the cut; forecasts revised up for Q1-Q3 2026
